About this Event

BOLLYWOOD DIWALI DANDIYA for cause-A greener, cleaner planet supporting ROTARY CLUB OF SILICON ANDHRA
Join us at BOLLYWOOD DIWALI DANDIYA NIGHT 2026 on 25TH Oct at Aria University, Milpitas at 6:30 pm till 9:30 pm with 30 min of free Garba dance workshop at 7:00 pm. Gates open at 6 pm. A NIGHT OF DANCING FOR ALL with Dazzling Disco Lights!
A NIGHT OF DANCING FOR ALL with Dazzling Disco Lights!
* Food and Beverages available for Purchase.
* Nonstop Music by DJ-Vdesi Jam
* Prizes for Best Garba Attire Male/Female/Child
* Dandiya sticks will be available on-site to purchase.
For group discounts and sponsorship, please contact at the numbers listed in the flyer
Please buy your tickets soon before it's too late!!
Looking Forward to meeting you all!
